description: This file defines the SaveEmploymentStatusController class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the component setup for editing or saving employment status entities based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveEmploymentStatusController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing Vue components related to saving or editing employment status entries, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering, choosing between 'employment-status-edit' and 'employment-status-save' based on request data and adding necessary properties.
